title: Evidence Before Entry
topic: Why incomplete intraday evidence should produce a no-trade decision
disclosure: Paper-trading education only; not live-money performance; not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.

scenes.title: Evidence first
scenes.narration: A disciplined trading process starts before any order. First, verify the evidence chain.

scenes.title: Timestamp matters
scenes.narration: Use completed, timestamped bars. An unfinished candle can change the story.

scenes.title: Fresh quote
scenes.narration: Then verify that the quote is fresh and the spread is acceptable for the intended route.

scenes.title: Intraday confirmation
scenes.narration: For an intraday entry, price context matters. Check VWAP and the required completed candle sequence.

scenes.title: No evidence, no order
scenes.narration: If any required check is missing or ambiguous, the correct action is to hold or take no trade.

scenes.title: Process over pressure
scenes.narration: Good process does not promise returns. It protects the decision from unsupported assumptions.

youtube_title: Evidence Before Entry | Why No Trade Can Be the Right Decision
